I am a Senior Instructional Professor in the Department of Computer Science, where I [teach](teaching.qmd) introductory Computer Science, software development, and computer networks.

As the department's [Director of Teaching and Learning](teaching-and-learning.qmd), I support the department's teaching mission in a variety of ways, including running our course staff training programs and advising instructors on matters of pedagogy and educational technologies.

I am involved in a number of [other activities](other.qmd) on campus, such as being the faculty advisor to the department's student organizations.

My past [research](research.qmd) has primarily focused on resource allocation on distributed systems using virtualization. I have [published](publications.qmd) a number of papers on those subjects and, more recently, I have also published some papers on Computer Science Education.
